title: Farm and Generator Machines
subtitle: Working the world around them
text:
Crop Harvester: harvests and replants grown crops in a 5x5 area in front (9x9 on steel), 400 FE a crop.
Shearer: shears sheep in the same area, 500 FE a sheep.
Stone Generator: cobblestone from water and lava, 10 FE/t.
Water Generator: fills buckets beside 2 water sources, 10 FE/t.
Mechanical Hive: honeycomb and honey bottles, 20 FE/t.
